title: An indirect signal can be the only measurement available, and must be labelled as one
problem: The quantity of interest cannot be measured, and only a correlated signal is available.
failure: The correlated signal was reported as if it were the quantity, and a later reader built on it as a measurement.
correction: Keep the signal, label it BOUNDED_PROXY, and state what it does and does not establish.
transfer: An indirect measurement is usable; an indirect measurement reported as direct is not. The defect is the label, not the method.
limits: FIXTURE. Test data for tests/retrieval_bilingual_R02.py. Deliberately close to fx-direct-probe: both concern proxies, and they prescribe opposite actions.
author: FIXTURE
